title: Evidence change context
description: change.json in an evidence/v1 export: the change context the chain vouches for. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; every field other than ticket equals what the records derive (state, plan_digest, author, author_runs, repair counters); ticket equals the ticket the attestation signs; state is at most 32 bytes; author is at most 256 bytes; at most 1024 author_runs; the file is at most 1 MiB. Zero values are omitted, never written.

export_version.description: The export layout version; 1 in evidence/v1.

state.description: Lifecycle state token, such as closed, abandoned or rolled_back for an ended change.

author.description: Principal name of the single author agent; printable ASCII, at most 256 bytes.

ticket.description: The ticket leaf: the literal none, or a reference of 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters without space or # followed by # and the digest of the ticket.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: the prefix sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.
